feed.headline: Russia Revives Demand That NATO Retrench to Secure Ukraine Deal
feed.ai: The hard-line position of Russian officials in closed-door negotiations about ending the war thrusts European security into the heart of the talks.

feed.headline: Qatar and Turkey sign defence agreement for “unified position” facing external attacks
feed.ai: A fast-moving reshape of the Gulf and Middle East multilateral security landscape is underway, triggered by the Iran war and the US signals that it is adapting its long-standing security presence in the region.

feed.headline: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
feed.ai: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.

feed.headline: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
feed.ai: The Ukrainian president says the slowed-down internet is making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

feed.headline: Cash Hidden in Forests? Hungary Goes After Corruption Under Orban
feed.ai: The new government says $20 million worth of bank notes uncovered in farmhouses and woods are the “tip of the iceberg.” Allies of Viktor Orban, the former prime minister, call it a witch hunt.

feed.headline: Putin Is Open to Meeting With North Korea’s Leader in China, Kremlin Says
feed.ai: President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia could meet with Kim Jong-un if he travels to Shenzhen for the APEC summit this week. North Korea has not confirmed whether Mr. Kim will attend.

feed.headline: Leaked Records Show Deutsche Bank Courting Russian Oligarchs
feed.ai: “As you know we have a large Russian Oligarchs client population,” an analyst wrote as the bank braced for sanctions against wealthy clients.

feed.headline: Ukraine’s Starshield Access Is Being Restricted Again, Zelensky Says
feed.ai: President Volodymyr Zelensky said the system, which Ukraine uses to guide drones, was being throttled over Russian-occupied territory. SpaceX, its developer, has denied the claim.

feed.headline: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
feed.ai: The US has not confirmed the Ukrainian president's comments - a US official told the BBC "many ideas continue to be discussed".

feed.headline: Hungarian authorities uncover $20m during probe of Orbán-era minister
feed.ai: Prime Minister Péter Magyar promised a sweeping anti-corruption drive after ousting Orbán in April.

feed.headline: Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks
feed.ai: The Ukrainian president says it makes sense for European leaders to be involved as Ukraine hopes to eventually join the EU.

feed.headline: One of France’s Most Popular Athletes Is Running for President
feed.ai: Centrists want alternatives to a matchup between the far right and far left in the 2027 presidential race. Enter Christine Lagarde, a former central banker — and Teddy Riner, a judo star.
